title: Veltrix
subtitle: Local Image Processing & Editing Platform
description: A browser-based image processing tool built for fast, privacy-focused batch editing. Import multiple images, crop, rotate, resize, compress, rename, and export them directly in the browser without uploading files to a server.

title: Speakwise
subtitle: AI Speech Practice Platform
description: An AI-powered speech practice platform that helps users improve their communication by recording speech, transcribing responses, analyzing speaking patterns, and generating personalized feedback and improvement suggestions.

title: FFkit
subtitle: FFmpeg TUI & Developer Tool
description: A command-line interface for FFmpeg with a focus on developer productivity and ease of use.

title: Solana Wallet Monitor
subtitle: Real-Time Solana Wallet Tracking
description: A lightweight Web3 application for monitoring Solana wallets, providing real-time balance information and transaction activity through blockchain APIs in a simple, accessible interface.
